facts.content: Patient has had a sore throat for 1 week followed by a dry cough.
Sore throat began on Thursday or Friday last week.
facts.source_text: Timeline: sore throat began Fri/Thu last wk

facts.content: Dry cough began 1-2 days after the sore throat.
Shortness of breath started 3-4 days ago.
The cough is dry, constant, and not nocturnal without sputum or hemoptysis.
facts.source_text: Cough: dry, constant, not nocturnal; no sputum/hemoptysis

facts.content: Shortness of breath is mild and exertional, patient can still climb stairs and exercise.
facts.source_text: SOB: mild, exertional; still climbs stairs/exercises

facts.content: Wheezing and mild chest pain are present.
Fever was present for the first 3 days and has now resolved.
Patient has intermittent headaches.
Patient's appetite is decreased but there is no weight loss.
No nasal or sinus congestion or rashes noted.
Patient has no past medical history.
Mother has lung cancer.
Patient takes no medications.
Patient is allergic to peanuts.
Patient is a non-smoker with occasional experimentation and was born in the US, living in the UK for 12 years.
facts.source_text: non-smoker (only rare experimentation); born US, in UK ×12 yrs

facts.content: Patient has traveled recently only within Europe.
Patient is employed and requested a sick note.
Diagnosis of acute viral upper respiratory tract infection/pharyngitis with dry cough and mild shortness of breath.
facts.source_text: Acute viral URTI/pharyngitis with dry cough & mild SOB

facts.content: Absence from work due to illness is noted.
Patient has a history of peanut allergy.
Conservative treatment with paracetamol, fluids, rest, expecting improvement in 4-5 days.
facts.source_text: Conservative Tx – paracetamol, fluids, rest; expect improvement ≤4–5 d

facts.content: Advised to seek emergency or GP care if increased SOB, new/worsening chest pain, fever recurrence, or no improvement in more than 5 days.
facts.source_text: Safety-net: ED/GP if ↑SOB, new/worsening chest pain, fever recurrence, or no improvement >5 d

facts.content: Issue sick note for additional days off work.
facts.source_text: Issue sick note for additional days off work

facts.content: Advise continued avoidance of peanuts and carry emergency medications if prescribed, none currently.
facts.source_text: Continue avoidance of peanuts; carry emergency meds if prescribed (none currently)
